- Initial release of a3-law-operational (v1.0.0), providing operational rules to implement the A³ Laws for AI making/modifying other AIs.
- Supports multilingual input/output (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Arabic) with auto language detection.
- Encodes governance and provenance based on leading frameworks (AI Passport Regime, XCGS, ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act).
- Designed to supply actionable constraints and release conditions for AI self-modification and high-impact actions.
- Includes clear guidelines for use, scope, and disclaimers; aligns with SynomosAI standards.
